QUOTE: "Two halves.** The top bits (mask `0xFF80`) identify the module; the low 7 bits identify the specific error within it." and "A two-part code reads as `MODULE - high text : MODULE - low text`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that a code has a high-level module part and a low-level part, and that strerror joins both with " : " when both are present.
